review_description: I had Amazon Solar install a 13KW system for us with SolarEdge optimisers in 2023. During the project they ordered the wrong panels. They then told me they were out of cash to get the replacements and asked me to pay early. I declined to pay early, and somehow they came up with the right panels.Our system had significant stability problems after installation. It turned out the inverter was faulty, but it took Amazon Solar over six months to return to site to resolve the problem.After they did the work to fix the fault with the system, I discovered they had cracked some tiles on our roof and didn't tell us.Five months ago one of our optimisers failed. It's been impossible to get Amazon Solar back out to replace the faulty optimiser.AmazonSolar was about $300 cheaper than another quote. Worst $300 I've ever saved.
Clearly explained the product features and after care support. Highly recommended
